cues.en: So what actually is the formal derivative of the natural log?
cues.zh: 那自然對數正式的導數，究竟是什麼？

cues.zh: 就是 1/x，所以 ln(x) 的導數是 1/x。

cues.en: Now this function on its own is defined for all x except for zero, including negative numbers.
cues.zh: 這個函數本身，對除了零之外的所有 x 都有定義，包括負數。

cues.en: But the original function is defined only for positive x, so the derivative has the domain restricted also to x greater than zero.
cues.zh: 但原函數只對正的 x 定義，所以導數的定義域，也限制為 x 大於零。

So this term actually just turns into one for the natural log and.
